title: Domain "for each basic land type" counts only basic lands (28 cards)
body:
"For each basic land type among lands you control" adds `IsSupertype(Basic)`, so nonbasic lands such as Breeding Pool aren't counted. "The number of basic land types among lands you control" is encoded correctly.

Affected: Draco, Drag Down, Evasive Action, Exotic Curse, Gaea's Might, Herd Migration, Jodah's Codex, Kavu Scout, Leyline Binding, Llanowar Greenwidow, Manaforce Mace, Might of Alara, Ordered Migration, Planar Despair, Power Armor, Radha's Firebrand, Scion of Draco, Spore Burst, Stratadon, Strength of Unity, Sunbathing Rootwalla, Tromp the Domains, Voices from the Void, Wandering Goblins, Wandering Stream, Wandering Treefolk, Wayfaring Giant, Yavimaya Sojourner
